title: ANU direct international admission – Semester 1, 2027
summary: ANU direct applications for international undergraduate and postgraduate admission. Australian and New Zealand citizens, Australian permanent residents and permanent humanitarian visa holders are outside this route. Applicants taking Australian Year 12, the IB Diploma or New Zealand NCEA are directed to UAC. Courses with additional selection criteria may set different application deadlines. Offer acceptance is a separate step.
